entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: 成功は、source/target domain、constructとoutcome meaning、population/context shift、evidence comparability、threshold/confidence transfer assumptions、domain-local results、transfer claim status、governance routingを決定論的に再現し、pooled performanceを品質や移送可能性の証明へ格上げせず、npm test・portable・AOF組織検証・公開releaseを完了すること。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: Proceed with the smallest additive calibration-report slice: transfer policy, domain profile, domain-local result, transportability comparison, assessment, governance, verifier, examples, fixtures, docs, portable release.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: No independently verified multi-domain operational dataset is committed, so construct equivalence, real generalization, representativeness, calibration truth, and safe transfer remain unestablished.
entries.expectation_state: Transportability policy, source and target profiles, domain-local result separation, ten-dimension comparison, bounded transfer status, assessment, governance, documentation, fixtures, and portable validation are complete; the example remains unsupported, example-only, and insufficient.
entries.mismatch_state: No independently verified multi-domain operational dataset is committed, so construct equivalence, real generalization, representativeness, calibration truth, and safe transfer remain unestablished.
